name: 骨鉴卿心
overview: After dying under false accusations, forensic pathologist Yan Qing awakens in the chaotic Xin Kingdom armed with knowledge far ahead of her time. As she investigates a series of shocking murder cases, she forms an uneasy alliance with the cold and powerful Shi Ting. Together, they expose conspiracies, challenge corrupt power structures, and navigate a dangerous path where justice and love become inseparable.
